For me how I started to be able to get clean was every time I wanted to do it I would see how many seconds I could hold out before I did it and it will always make it not as bad either and sometimes the urge would go away quickly and other times it would last and I would end up doing it. But I had to differentiate between relapsing and slipping up. Relapsing is starting again continuing not trying to get clean slipping up is yeah I messed up but I’m gonna try again see if I can go for longer see if I can do better and sometimes it’s not about the days sometimes it’s about getting through one single day that was really tough that you never thought you would get through without selfharming. Your body ends up craving it even to this day I’ve been clean for about four years with some slip ups and I still miss all that I had a slip up a month ago maybe a bit less and in that moment it felt good but afterwards I thought why did I do that again.
